_comment: Zero-token AXC write boundary for Copilot CLI preToolUse. Tune here; enforce via write-boundary.py from enforce-agent-workflow.sh. Do not vendor .claude/settings.json.
_comment_agents_work: .agents-work/** is for Copilot multi-agent workflow markers only; SCORE default path does not load .github/agents/*.
path_deny: Lockfile. Prefer existing workspace deps; do not rewrite the lockfile.
bash_deny: Adding a dependency rewrites the lockfile outside the write boundary. Prefer workspace packages; state the need in notes instead of installing. (Bare `pnpm install` to restore the lockfile is allowed.)
